downstreamMapping.purpose: Private actual Met/MM culture context; CD126 CAR/macrophage and K562 findings not new clinical regimens/profiles

reviewInputs.answer: Met decreases RPMI8226 culture signals and changes CD126; CAR/macrophage context matters, without proof of clinical benefit or isolated CAR synergy.

sourceQualifications.description: Cell-line/healthy-donor-cell culture study, no own animals or treated MM clinical patients. N4-9/6/9 and three repeats are not unique donors/patients. Primary donor/CAR donor hierarchy unknown; HPA reuse is not a new clinical cohort.

Reused HPA cell-line expression snapshot accessed29Nov2025, not freshly queried/current or independently verified protein quantity. IL6 5ng/ml48h increases RPMI luciferase1.40fold; unstimulated THP1 addition null. CD163/iNOS ratio8.61fold at5ng/ml24h and7.90 at10, no dose-gradient response.

THP1 leukemia-derived/PMA50ng/ml, M1 IFNg20/LPS10ng/ml24h, M2 IL4/IL13 20ng/ml48h. iNOS/CD163 marker ratio is not complete phenotypic reprogramming; binary M1/M2 and THP1 do not reproduce full human TME. Primary verification mostly unchecked companions.

M1 co-culture lowers RPMI luciferase at48h, absent differential M1 suppression in indirect transwell. Direct/indirect common-baseline normalization differs, not an isolated cytokine necessity proof. Body1.68/1.92/2.03fold decreases retain comparator/time; not clinical tumor shrinkage.

RPMI CD11C-negative cells, AnnexinV+/PI+ defines LATE apoptosis. Printed Fig2C/body7.33% M1 versus3.26 control/4.42 M0/4.52 M2 are representative quadrant values, not independently confirmed aggregate mean/total apoptosis. No forced raw flow-event or biological denominator reconstruction. Methods2.6 physical3 specifies24h RPMI/macrophage apoptosis incubation; Fig2C/D caption does not separately state time. Growth and contact/transwell48h do not assign48h to flow.

CXCL10 body7196versus205.3pg/ml with M1/RPMI48h, but IL6/IL10 supernatant between macrophage co-cultures no significant differences as uncheckedS1G/H narrative. CXCL10 association not proven causal recruitment or in-vivo immune benefit.

Met1mM72h Fig3A/B versus0/1/5mM72h CD126MFI/viability Fig3C/D. Marker-ratio3.86fold reduction under IL6 is not24h IL6 ratio experiment. Met5mM CD1261.85fold reduction and macrophage increments retained; MFI/growth association does not establish CD126-mediated necessity or specific binding.

AntiIL6 antibody purchased in Methods, but no displayed neutralization/IL6R genetic rescue establishes necessity for Met action. Tocilizumab epitope similarity describes CAR construct, not administered clinical tocilizumab comparison. Cited prior IL6 mechanism not accepted as new experiment.

CD126 CAR-T versus UTD after macrophage pre-culture24h then T24h, E:T1:1/1:2. M0/M2 reduce RPMI killing with1:1 CAR, M1 not uniform identical inhibition. CAR also kills CD126-expressing macrophages: M0 late apoptosis8.42fold main; M1/M2 from unchecked supplements. Not validated exhaustion or clinical immune toxicity.

PBMC-derived M1 growth suppression and macrophage effects are main narratives of unreadS3; CAR-inhibition trend explicitly NOT statistically significant, no promotion to independent donor replication. Total healthy donor N/selection unknown.

Met1/5mM pretreat RPMI24h then CAR24h versus concurrent24h. This is tumor pretreatment, not CAR-only metabolic preconditioning, rapamycin regimen or72h CAR assay. Targets are CD126, not cited BCMA/GPRC5D/glioma CAR variants.

Pretreatment body1.84/38.37fold additional raw luciferase reductions at1/5mM are not isolated CAR killing fractions or formal synergy. Met-alone/UTD conditions also reduce signal; luciferase/metabolic effects not direct tumor Annexin apoptosis. No CI/Bliss/Loewe/raw normalized interaction model. Concurrent1mM Fig5B has no marked additional CAR comparison; do not claim uniform enhancement at both schedules/doses.

Met alone does not significantly alter CAR functional markers. Tumor encounter raises CD25/GranzymeB/PD1 with/without Met; GranzymeB marker increases further with Met plus CAR/tumor. Marker abundance is not catalytic activity or durable exhaustion reversal; PD1 up is not measured chronic functional exhaustion.

CD126-negative K562 has no direct CAR effect alone; macrophage presence permits reduced K562 luciferase after CAR. This is distinct leukemia/context with no accepted MM Met effect or acquired K562 CD126. CD126 expression remains nonsignificantly changed after macrophage co-culture.

BioTracker555 transfers K562-to-macrophages, not reverse in main figures, compatible with contact/material uptake, not exclusive proof of phagocytosis or antigen-specific direct K562 targeting. CFSE and cytochalasinD5uM inhibition are main narrative of uncheckedS6B; not independently inspected rescue panel or complete mechanism.

No human Met/CAR PK, effective oral dose, own animal exposure/survival or comprehensive healthy-cell/clinical safety. mM culture effects and ex-vivo healthy macrophages do not establish safe clinical adjuvant therapy or benefit from macrophage depletion.

S1-S6 not supplied/read; U266/MM1S, primary macrophage, phagocytosis and GPRC5D/other CAR cited studies remain explicitly context. Multiple assays/ratios/healthy-cell preparations not new independent trials/patients; no cross-corpus donor independence adjudicated.

Mayo authors XuanyouLiu/IrisKemler/DavidDingli, CenturionFund via MayoDevelopment. No commercial/financial conflict as declared. Cell-line ethics exemption and separate primary-cell MayoIRB approval both reported, no identifier/consent details; no inferred wrongdoing. Authors declare no generativeAI manuscript use, publisher states AI-supported alttext separately.

MeansSEM, experiments repeated3, caption N4-9/6/9 does not identify unique biological unit. Unpaired t-test/ANOVA Tukey not global multiplicity/power/blinding plan. Own14text/all6materialfigures5-10 read; raw flow/gating/data/protocol/current integrity and companions unchecked, no acquisition.
